name: solidmd
description: Fast, stable Markdown editor with live preview

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run prepare:dist && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run prepare:dist && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run prepare:dist && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run prepare:dist && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run check:deps && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run check:acceptance
